question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Crime of killing a king
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Regicide"** means the act of killing a king. (राजा की हत्या)

 
 
• **Example: **The conspirators were charged with regicide after the assassination of the king.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pesticide** (कीटनाशक): A substance used for destroying insects or other organisms harmful to cultivated plants or to animals.

 
 
• **Example:** Farmers use** pesticides** to protect their crops from pests.
 
 
 
• **Homicide** (हत्या): The deliberate and unlawful killing of one person by another.
 
 
• **Example:** The detective investigated the **homicide **case thoroughly.
 
 
 
• **Genocide** (नरसंहार): The deliberate killing of a large number of people from a particular nation or ethnic group with the aim of destroying that nation or group.
 
 
• **Example:** The historical event was a tragic example of **genocide.**
